subject: New bank account for Paperline Supplies payments
body_text:
Dear Bob,

Please note that Paperline Supplies has changed banks. All open invoices, including INV-20431,
must be paid to the new account listed in the attached letter. Payments to the old account will be returned.
Please update your supplier records today.

Kind regards,
Sarah Mitchell
Paperline Supplies

body_text:
